landing.title: Discover what to study
landing.subtitle: Lybanhi helps you find the right career, best universities for your budget, and prepares you for exams.
landing.f1Desc: Tell us your hobbies, skills and interests.
landing.f2Desc: Personalized recommendations and universities for you.
landing.featuresTitle: Your career future shouldn't be a guessing game
landing.featuresSubtitle: Forget about long, boring questionnaires. Our interactive recommender analyzes your real interests.
landing.step2Desc: Writing code, designing brands, making music...
landing.step3Desc: Adjust your monthly budget and choose public or private universities.
landing.resultDesc: You have a strong logical and creative profile, ideal for designing complex software systems.
landing.prepTitle: Prepare for the exams that define your future
landing.prepSubtitle: Adaptive study tools focused on university admissions and international certifications.
landing.prep1Desc: Dynamic Math, Science, and Logic quizzes tailored to real entrance exams.
landing.prep2Desc: Focused modules specifically for TOEFL and Cambridge to certify your level.
landing.prep3Desc: AI detects your weaknesses and instantly generates personalized practice questions.
landing.gamesSubtitle: Use your graduation caps to compete, explore, and collect avatars!
landing.game1Desc: Manage and expand your own virtual university campus in 2.5D.
landing.game2Desc: Fast-paced trivia quizzes to open chest multipliers and outsmart AI.
landing.game3Desc: Get answers right to speed up your rocket ship and win the race.
landing.game4Desc: Explore and build in a modular 3D sandbox.
landing.economyTitle: Your effort turns into real rewards
landing.economySubtitle: A positive loop that keeps you motivated to learn day after day.
landing.economy1Desc: Complete daily quizzes to gain XP and keep your streak alive.
landing.economy2Desc: Trade your hard-earned study XP for Graduation Caps easily.
landing.economy3Desc: Buy fashionable clothing sets and pets to look amazing.
landing.footerTitle: Ready to map out your career success?
landing.heroFeature1Desc: Analyze your hobbies, skills, and budget to find your ideal career path.
landing.heroFeature2Desc: Master admission exams and certifications like TOEFL or Cambridge with smart reviews.
landing.heroFeature3Desc: Earn XP, convert it to coins, and unlock minigames and collectible avatars.
